messages:
oncall-bot: [ALERT] p95 latency SLO breach for Sable Enterprises (VPC: eu-west-1, dedicated pool). p95=1.22s (SLO 300ms), p99=3.58s. Triggered 2026-03-15T14:12:08Z. Paging #eng-sre #eng-runtime #product-ss.
sre_jen: oncall here — opening triage. grabbing traces + tail logs now.
raj_kapoor: I see a spike in request queue length on pool-scheduler starting 14:09Z. Could be batching/backpressure. Any deploys 14:00-14:10?
platform_oncall: no application deploys. autoscaler kicked at 14:10:12Z and we evicted 2 workers for pod churn. kernel logs show OOM kills on one node earlier.
maria_se: looping in Sable account team (cc @sam_se). Maria — asking for visible customer-impact (which products, errors vs slow)
sam_se: Sable confirms increased latency in their chat endpoint and some timeouts for long prompts. No changes on their side.
sre_jen: quick health check: errors are low (~0.4%) but tail latencies huge. Top offender: /api/v1/generate (chat) and /api/v1/embeddings. Likely KV cache warmup + eviction.
kevin_am: I can try a hotfix: switch heavy traffic to the warm spare pool in eu-north while we stabilize eu-west. Need approval to update routing policy.
raj_kapoor: +1. Also recommend temporarily decreasing max_batch_size and reducing batch_wait_ms to lower p95 during high concurrency.
platform_oncall: initiating tenant isolation: will move Sable to isolated routing (traffic-shift) and spin up 2 warm spares on NVMe-backed nodes. ETA ~8-10m.
sre_jen: running diagnostic commands; pasting tail of scheduler logs:
```
[14:09:58] pool-scheduler: enqueue request id=abc123 latency=0.31s
[14:10:12] autoscaler: scaleUp nodes=2 reason=batch_growth
[14:10:20] node-12: kubelet evict memory pressure pod=gateway-54
[14:11:05] runtime: KV cache miss rate jump from 12% -> 78%
```
raj_kapoor: that KV miss jump matches cold-cache after eviction. Let's prefill caches for top 50 keys for Sable.
kevin_am: running prefill job now. command:
```
redwoodctl jobs run --job=prefill-kv --tenant=sable --top=50 --region=eu-west-1
```
maria_se: Sable on the line — they asked if we can route a % of traffic to a quantized model variant (7B-q) to reduce latency/cost during mitigation.
sre_jen: plan: 1) immediate traffic-shift to warm spare eu-north (10% cutover then ramp), 2) reduce batch size & batch timeout, 3) prefill KV top keys, 4) enable model-fallback to 7B-q for long prompts, 5) cordon noisy node.
platform_oncall: started traffic-shift (10% -> 50%). scaling warm-spare replicas + cordon node-12.
kevin_am: prefill job finished. KV miss-rate down to 18% for Sable.
sre_jen: after 18:38 of mitigation: p95=340ms, p99=720ms — still above SLO but much better. continuing to ramp traffic back.
sam_se: Sable confirms noticeable improvement. They want ETA for full recovery and RCA.
raj_kapoor: ETA for full recovery if no regressions ~25 minutes. RCA hypothesis: eviction during autoscale caused KV cache thrash leading to increased per-token compute latency and repeated long batches.
sre_jen: opening post-incident ticket: INC-6198765432. Actions: migrate Sable to NVMe-backed dedicated nodes, add proactive prefill on scale events, tighten eviction thresholds, add canary for autoscaler changes.
maria_se: I'll schedule a customer sync with Sable for 14:00 tomorrow to review impact and permanent mitigations.
oncall-bot: [UPDATE] mitigation in progress. Current p95=0.34s, p99=0.72s. Will update in 10m or on status change. :thumbsup:
